messages:
Alex R: Kicking off observability finalization in eu-central-5. Logs/metrics/traces should be provisioned for new GPU cluster (c5-gpu-pool). Not seeing traces in Honeycomb yet. Can someone run the smoke validation and cost quick-check? Thanks.
Maria P: On it. I will run the validation checklist and ping results. @Samir K can you confirm kube-proxy MTU? :eyes: 
DeployBot: deployment redwood-telemetry-agent eu-central-5 succeeded (rev 3) at 2024-08-13T10:01:23Z
Maria P: Ran `kubectl -n observability get pods` — a few telemetry-agent pods CrashLoopBackOff. Paste logs: ```kubectl -n observability logs redwood-telemetry-agent-2 -c agent
ERROR: failed to connect to ingest.honeycomb.example.net: dial tcp 35.198.12.34:443: i/o timeout
```
Samir K: Network egress to ingest endpoint is routing via us-east-1 NAT, high p95 RTT ~300ms. Need to update route table to use eu-central-5 egress. Also noticed MTU mismatch on GPU nodes (9000 vs 1500) causing packet fragmentation. Will open a PR to set node annotation `network.alpha.kubernetes.io/mtu: "9000"`.
Maria P: For immediate fix, I've bumped telemetry agent DNS TTL and added `--ingest-timeout=10s` in DaemonSet to avoid tight retries. Recovered 4/6 agents. Cost note: current logs retention 30d = ~€1.2k/mo for this cluster. Recommend 7d for now: saves ~70%.
Jin W: Dashboard templates: pushing `eu-c5-gpu-observability.json` to dashboards repo with panels: node_cpu, gpu_mem, telemetry_ingest_errors, trace_latency_p95. Alerting templates: `telemetry.agent_down` (5m, severity=page), `telemetry.ingest_errors` (>5% over 10m, severity=page), `telemetry.latency.p95` (>500ms for 5m, severity=sev2). Example Alert rule: ```expr: sum(rate(telemetry_ingest_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(telemetry_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
labels: severity:page
annotations: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-agent-insert```
Elena: noted handoff. Oncall @Samir K please take primary for network change; Maria will monitor agent recovery. I'll create the handoff ticket RU-8723. :thumbsup: 
Samir K: Starting route update and will test. ETA 15m.
Maria P: Agents healthy now, traces showing up in Honeycomb. Keeping retention at 7d for 24h to monitor cost and volume.
Alex R: Great, thanks all. Leaving this thread for the oncall handoff. :white_check_mark:
